title: Triggered Walmart Worker Threatens to Shoot Co-Worker: Cops
description:
A Walmart employee was caught on police body cameras moments after allegedly making threatening remarks about shooting a coworker. Police took Adrienne Edwards, 36, into custody outside of the store in Tulsa, Oklahoma, after witnesses told police she was allegedly upset and yelling before making remarks related to shooting another coworker. That’s when one witness, knowing Edwards was in possession of a firearm, alerted staff to the alleged threat. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
